scope: Archived v5 development example; no current-v6/community agent score. API response text is excluded.

certificate.boundary: Stylized complete rigid object; ideal connectors, collisions and straight paths.

semantics.GT: One feasible witness; alternative legal order is accepted.
semantics.valid: Physically legal action and no out-of-goal installed piece; incompleteness is allowed.
semantics.wrongPose: An installed piece does not match any target placement, although its action may be legal.
semantics.externalFault: Injected environment change, not a model error.
semantics.finish: Success requires correct final geometry, not matching GT at intermediate steps.
